_doc: Tầm Kiếm Đường's Effect engine records (world-depth Stage 6; ADR-0009). Input to tools/design/combat_sim/put_effects.py under source world-depth:tam_kiem. Unpriced. Rule text from design/world/depth/sects/tam_kiem.items.json.

The Second Duel.rule: Evening Sword: against a foe who has already dealt a damaging hit to you this fight, your sword arts deal 10 % more damage.

The Answer.rule: The Map Wall, full set (2 pieces): each Ask mark on the foe raises your next The Blade Answers cut's crit damage by 10 %; a The Blade Answers cut that spends 5 or more Ask marks ignores half of the foe's ward shields (bypass 0.5, the engine's bypass_cap).
The Answer.approx: "ignores the foe's ward" is bypass 0.5, the engine's bypass_cap; a full ward pass exists only on free hits (pass_shields)
